name: Grilled Zucchini and Corn Salad

cookwares.name: large chimney starter (if using charcoal grill)

ingredients.name: finely chopped shallot, from 1 small shallot
halloumi cheese, halved horizontally and patted dry
chopped fresh herbs, such as basil, mint, and/or dill

instructions.primary_message:
For a Charcoal Grill: Open bottom vent completely. Light large chimney starter filled 3/4 with charcoal briquettes (4 quarts). When top coals are partially covered with ash, pour evenly over bottom of grill. Set cooking grate in place, cover, and open lid vent completely. Heat grill until hot, about 5 minutes.
For a Gas Grill: Turn all burners to high, cover, and preheat grill until hot, about 15 minutes. Leave all burners on high.

While the grill heats, in a small bowl, whisk together vinegar and shallot; let sit until shallot begins to soften, about 5 minutes. Add mustard, pepper jelly or hot honey, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/2 teaspoon pepper and whisk until smooth. Slowly drizzle in 1/4 cup oil, whisking constantly, until fully incorporated. Set dressing aside.

Clean and oil cooking grate. Brush corn and halloumi with 2 tablespoons oil. Place corn on oiled grill grates and grill, uncovered, turning occasionally, until spotty brown on all sides, about 10 minutes; transfer to a large plate.

Brush zucchini with remaining 2 tablespoons oil. Grill zucchini, cut sides down, and halloumi until zucchini is well browned on both sides and tender and halloumi has grill marks, 6 to 10 minutes for the zucchini and 4 to 6 minutes for the halloumi; transfer to plate with corn as they finish cooking. Grill lemon, cut-sides down, until charred, about 2 minutes.

Once cool enough to handle, transfer zucchini, corn, and halloumi to a cutting board, working with one ingredient at a time. Cut zucchini crosswise on a diagonal into 1-inch pieces and transfer to a large bowl. Cut halloumi into 1/2-inch pieces and transfer to bowl with zucchini. Cut corn kernels from cobs and transfer to bowl with zucchini; discard cobs.

Add sunflower seeds, herbs, 1/4 cup dressing, remaining 1 teaspoon kosher salt, and remaining 1/2 teaspoon pepper and toss to combine. Transfer to a large platter. Drizzle with remaining 3 tablespoons dressing and squeeze grilled lemon over top. Serve.

description: This grilled summer zucchini and corn salad combines smoky vegetables, salty halloumi, fresh herbs, and a tangy vinaigrette.
notes:
Optional substitutions: hot pepper jelly → hot honey

Make-ahead and storage: Dressing can be made up to 4 days in advance and refrigerated in an airtight container.
Leftover salad can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 4 days.
author: Laila Ibrahim
